One team for the whole building system

Five connected services, designed together so your cameras, doors, intercoms and network work as one system — not five separate problems. Pricing is confirmed by phone for your building.

Representative photo

Security Cameras

Camera coverage planned around how your building actually moves — entrances, lobbies, hallways, loading areas and perimeters — so the views that matter are the ones you have.

Confirm details by phone
Representative photo

Access Control

Decide exactly who can enter, where, and when. Fob, keypad and managed entry systems replace loose keys with control you can update as staff and tenants change.

Confirm details by phone
Representative photo

Intercom Systems

See and speak with visitors before they step inside. Intercom systems for building entrances, offices and multi-tenant properties across the five boroughs.

Confirm details by phone
Representative photo

Networking

The backbone every other system depends on. Structured cabling and network setup that keeps cameras, access panels and building systems reliably connected.

Confirm details by phone

Smart Home Automation

Lighting, locks and connected devices brought into one simple control setup — automation that fits daily life instead of complicating it.
